name: Copperpot Restaurants
description: Chain of 6 family restaurants in the fictional city of Dunhallow.

items.title: Published allergen incident statement
items.content: Copperpot publicly apologised after a child had a severe peanut reaction at its Quay Street restaurant on 2026-08-30; the satay sauce label was wrong. Statement CPR-ALG-0830 says all 6 sites retrained staff within 72 hours.

items.title: Kids eat free offer
items.content: Children under 11 eat free from 15:30 to 17:45 on weekdays with one adult main. Offer CPR-KEF-11.

items.title: Kitchen closing checklist
items.content: Fryers are filtered after 22:20 service; fridge temperatures must be below 3.8 C and logged in CPR-KC-38 by the closing chef, Matteo Ricci.

items.title: Tip sharing rules
items.content: Card tips are pooled weekly: 63.5% to front of house and 36.5% to kitchen. Rules CPR-TIP-62.

items.title: Pending hygiene re-inspection
items.content: Inspectors found mould in the Eastgate cold room on 2026-10-09; our rating may drop to 2 when results are published on 2026-11-20. Note CPR-MNU-246.

items.title: Restaurant sale to Bluefin Group
items.content: Copperpot will sell its Harbourside and Millgate sites to Bluefin Group for $2.2M on 2027-01-29; staff transfer under their current contracts. Deal CPR-SALE-0129-B.
